Name: Robin's Construction Queue
Author: Davizito76
Description:
[heading]How it works[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Purchase a building from Robin. [/*]
[*]The building is added to the queue instead of being built immediately. [/*]
[*]While Robin is working, [b]talk to her behind the Carpenter Shop counter[/b] to add another building to the queue or buy materials. [/*]
[*]When Robin finishes the current project, the next queued construction starts automatically. [/*]
[*]Repeat until the queue is empty.
Note: To keep the experience as close to vanilla as possible, the queue menu is only available while Robin is behind the Carpenter Shop counter during business hours. [/*]
[/list]
[heading]Robin's Construction Queue[/heading]
Tired of waiting for Robin to finish one building before ordering the next?
This mod lets you queue multiple construction projects while keeping the vanilla building process intact.
Robin still works on only one building at a time, but you can plan ahead and add new projects to a construction queue.

[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Queue up to [b]3[/b] construction projects. [/*]
[*]Robin builds [b]one structure at a time[/b], just like in vanilla. [/*]
[*]Queue survives saving and loading. [/*]
[*]Construction automatically starts when Robin finishes the previous project. [/*]
[*]Building cost and materials are preserved. [/*]
[*]Talk to Robin while she's busy to:
[list]
[*] Add another construction to the queue. [/*]
[*]Buy building materials. [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Prevents adding more projects when the queue is full.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]How it works[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Purchase a building from Robin. [/*]
[*]The building is added to the queue instead of being built immediately. [/*]
[*]When Robin becomes available, the next building automatically starts. [/*]
[*]Repeat until the queue is empty.[/*]
[/list]
